body_lead: Gujarat CM Launches Amul AI, Calls It Milestone For Dairy Sector Modernisation Gujarat Chief Minister called this a milestone in modernising agriculture, animal husbandry, and dairy development Gandhinagar: Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel on Tuesday inaugurated Amul AI, a digital platform aimed at transforming the dairy sector through Artificial Intelligence. The chief minister called this a milestone in modernising agriculture, animal husbandry, and dairy development. He said the initiative would further strengthen self-reliance under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
